title: Ravi Teja's Irumudi Trailer Launches at Massive Bhimavaram Event Ahead of August 21 Release
excerpt: Mythri Movie Makers unveils the theatrical trailer for Ravi Teja's spiritual family drama Irumudi at a grand event in Bhimavaram, with the film set for worldwide release on August 21.
body:
• The theatrical trailer for Ravi Teja's Irumudi was launched on August 12 at a grand event in Bhimavaram, Andhra Pradesh, with the actor attending in person.
  • Directed by Shiva Nirvana and produced by Mythri Movie Makers, the film releases worldwide on August 21 in Telugu and Tamil (as Irumudikattu).
  • Irumudi centers on a father-daughter story with Ayyappa devotion at its core, featuring Priya Bhavani Shankar and Baby Nakshatra alongside Ravi Teja.
  • The film's songs — "Irumudi Kattu" and "Mallepula Pallaki" — have already become chartbusters, with music by G.V. Prakash Kumar.

Mythri Movie Makers unveiled the theatrical trailer for Irumudi on August 12 at a grand launch event held at a private college in Bhimavaram, Andhra Pradesh. Ravi Teja attended the event in person, with the makers staging the trailer release on a massive scale ahead of the film's worldwide theatrical release on August 21.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=1VvdjCmq-sg

The trailer builds on the teaser's emotional foundation, presenting Ravi Teja as a devoted but imperfect father whose journey takes him through personal turmoil to spiritual redemption through the sacred Irumudi pilgrimage — a revered Ayyappa devotional tradition.

A Father-Daughter Story Rooted in Devotion

Irumudi — Ravi Teja's 77th film — marks his first collaboration with director Shiva Nirvana, known for family-oriented narratives and romantic dramas. The film centers on a father grappling with personal challenges while his relationship with his daughter, played by child actor Baby Nakshatra, forms the emotional core.

https://x.com/idlebraindotcom/status/2089013291893113184

The teaser, released on June 3 by T-Series Telugu, offered the first extended look at this dynamic. The 84-second clip showed Ravi Teja's character turning to alcohol after a personal tragedy before his daughter urges him to change, leading him to take the Ayyappa deeksha and carry the sacred Irumudi. The chants of "Swamiye Saranam Ayyappa" underscored a spiritual dimension that sets the film apart from Ravi Teja's typical action-heavy outings.

"Some stories choose you at the right moment in life. Feeling blessed to be part of one such story again, letting belief lead the way."

— Ravi Teja, on Irumudi

During the dubbing phase in July, the makers released a studio video featuring the powerful dialogue "I've only one daughter, and her name is Manamma," delivered with raw emotion by Ravi Teja, further stoking anticipation.

Music That Set the Tone Early

G.V. Prakash Kumar's score has been a significant driver of the film's pre-release buzz. The first single, "Irumudi Kattu," a devotional Ayyappa track, became an instant chartbuster after release. The second single, "Mallepula Pallaki," a soulful melody blending devotion with traditional Telugu musical elements, has also resonated widely with audiences.

Prakash Kumar's background score in the teaser drew particular praise, shifting between folk melodies and mass beats to match the film's tonal range from tender family scenes to high-voltage action.

Cast and Crew

Priya Bhavani Shankar plays the female lead opposite Ravi Teja, while Baby Nakshatra portrays their daughter. The supporting cast includes veteran actor Sai Kumar, Ajay Ghosh, Ramesh Indira, and Swasika in key roles. Vishnu Sarma handles cinematography, with Prawin Pudi as editor.

The film is produced by Naveen Yerneni and Y. Ravi Shankar of Mythri Movie Makers, with Gulshan Kumar, Bhushan Kumar, and T-Series Films as presenters. Shiva Nirvana directed and wrote the screenplay.

A Return to Emotional Storytelling

Industry observers have described Irumudi as a potential return to the grounded, emotionally honest filmmaking that defined Ravi Teja's earlier career. Films like Shambo Shiva Shambo, Neninthe, Naa Autograph, and Amma Nanna O Tamila Ammayi connected with audiences through relatable characters and genuine emotion, a space Ravi Teja has seldom revisited in recent years.

The teaser's reception on social media reflected this expectation. Actor-director Adivi Sesh praised it, saying "Absolutely loved this, sir. It's truly magical." Fans on X echoed the sentiment, with one asking, "Are we finally going to see the Ravi Teja we've been longing for?"

Telugu Cinema Fans Across the Diaspora

For the Telugu diaspora spread across the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, and the Gulf states, Irumudi's worldwide release on August 21 means same-day access. Telugu films have steadily grown their overseas footprint, and a Mythri Movie Makers production starring Ravi Teja carries built-in anticipation in NRI markets, particularly in the United States where Telugu cinema's premiere weekend collections have been climbing year over year.

With the trailer now launched and the release date just days away, Irumudi enters its final promotional stretch as one of the most anticipated Telugu films of the season.
nri_angle: Telugu diaspora worldwide will have same-day access to Irumudi on August 21, with NRI premiere collections continuing to climb for major Telugu releases.
